parsed.notes:
Aufgaben contains responsibilities; Profil contains requirements; Zusätzlich hilfreich marks the optional list; Wir bieten and Kontakt contain no candidate skill requirements.
Cloud is required through Cloud-Architekturen despite the earlier idealerweise clause.
Retrieval is provisionally mapped to RAG and mehrstufigen Workflows to LLM orchestration in the LLM context; both mappings are flagged because the literal wording is broader than those taxonomy entries.
Alternative groups use the example lists in Profil; group 3 also contains the unmapped A2A technology conceptually.
Systematic checking of AI-generated results is treated literally as AI output evaluation.
HOAI, Bürocontrolling, XRechnung and ZUGFeRD are excluded as domain or domain-standard knowledge; accounting and ERP software are retained as unmapped software categories.
No separate AI deployment criterion is inferred from deploying agents or AI functions, because model deployment is not explicitly requested.
